map.hint.edit:
Tools: Q drag objects freely, W move along axis arrows (Shift: whole metres), E rotate (round handle from above, rings in 3D; Shift: 15° steps), Del delete, 3 place objects.
Ctrl+click or Ctrl+drag selects several. Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undo and redo.
map.hint.variant:
Editing the chrono variant {title}: Q, W and E move and turn objects, Del deletes, 3 places objects; objects of the base map move as copies with new IDs.
Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undo and redo. Base map in the project browser ends editing.
map.hint.chrono: Click an object to inspect it. The chrono view is read-only; choose Base map in the project browser to edit.
map.hint.readonly: Click an object to inspect it. Save a project (File > Save map project as...) to edit the map.
